mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 13 degrees now, few clouds. Next 24 hours: high 15, low 9.

US and Israel are considering a new military strike against Iran in the coming days as tensions remain high.

Kosovo police carried out two anti-drug operations in Pristina, Gjakova and South Mitrovica, resulting in several arrests.

The Kosovo Energy Corporation and two unions have agreed to give all KEK employees a net bonus of €800.

In the Kosovar football league, Pristina defeated Drenica 3-0 at home, with Diatta scoring a hat-trick.

The prosecution said the DNA expert report in the trial of former appellate judge Gjoko Ristov contains no decisive findings, and the prosecutor sees no grounds to dismiss the case.
